text.p: The following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- The presentation of a new launch for the Border Guard took place at the Tallinn Ship Repair Plant.
- Estonian radio wants payment from local radio stations which use its news broadcasts.

- The refusal of residence permits to eight retired Russian officers should be reconsidered as the government had not been informed that their wives were Estonian citizens, Minister of Ethnic Affairs Andra Veidemann said.
- The Estonian Association of Large Enterprises has proposed to mediate between the Moscow Patriarchate and the Estonian Apostolic Orthodox church to bring a solution to their dispute.
- Russian Border Guard Chief Andrey Nikolayev, on an unofficial visit last week, hoped for a rapid signing of an Estonian-Russian border agreement.
- Estonia highly values the support of the United States, Foreign Minister Toomas Ilves told a reception in Washington to mark the 75th anniversary of diplomatic relations between the countries.
